regime_context: Hong Kong thematic leadership is narrow (only 4 of 17 themes eligible on the absolute-trend gate) and led by Energy (H-shares) with the strongest durability (0.76) and breadth (0.8), while Banks sit as a close challenger but with a crowded flag and mean-revert tag. The validated edge (gate_helps=true) is drawdown control, not return forecasting; rotation is display-only with no confirmed handoff, so any lean must carry low conviction. Nearly all themes are unscorable by proxy (only China Tech & Internet and Platform Megacaps have an ETF), which limits accountable grading.
emerging_watch: Watching whether High-Dividend Blue Chips (rank 3, score 1.212, durability 0.73, breadth 0.75, non-crowded) closes the gap on Banks and becomes a confirmed challenger — the observable condition would be High-Dividend overtaking Banks in rank with a durability_bar reading above Banks' own within the horizon.
